name: Current and Emerging Issues in Organizational Management
description: This is a dynamic course outline where we would incorporate the latest trends and developements in the organizations. This course explores the evolving dynamics of the modern workplace, focusing on key drivers of change such as technological advances, shifting societal values, and innovative leadership. Students will learn how to leverage behavioral insights to manage diverse teams, navigate workplace activism, ensure ethical decision-making, and foster creativity in a world shaped by emerging technologies like AI and hybrid work cultures.
